newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open slightly lower.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open slightly lower Friday in line with a modestly weaker bullion market overnight.
Trade is expected to be quiet ahead of Monday's U.K. bank holiday and in the wake of the May Day holidays in much of continental Europe Thursday.

More concern about central bank gold sales, producer hedging and renewed fund shorting pushed gold down to test four-year lows below $340 an ounce last week, but there has been little follow through this week, suggesting some shortcovering may occur Friday or next week, traders said.
